evidence.detail: R23 AssetVersion creates this class directly and installs it as the HyperlinkListener on its connection-failure JEditorPane; no other exact-v308 class constructs it.
hyperlinkUpdate reacts only to HyperlinkEvent.EventType.ACTIVATED, converts the event URL to a URI and opens it with Desktop.browse, printing IOException on failure.

The owning AssetVersion error pane contains the exact SpawnPK connectivity troubleshooting text and forum hyperlink, fixing this listener to the AssetVersion error/help UI rather than a generic browser utility.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the hyperlink listener owned exclusively by AssetVersion's connection-failure UI.
